subject: sentences
title: Where words
about: Little words that tell where or which way: in, on, under, over, off, to, with. Prepositions are on NC's K-1 grammar continuum and CKLA teaches them in Unit 6, in the second half of the year.
tip: Act it out with a toy and a box: put it in, on, under, then say the sentence together.

cards.q: Pick the word: The hat is ___ my head.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The hat is blank my head.
cards.note: A hat sits on top of your head. In, on and under tell where something is.

cards.q: Pick the word: The fish swims ___ the tank.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The fish swims blank the tank.
cards.note: The fish is inside the water, so it swims in the tank.

cards.q: Pick the word: Roots grow ___ the ground.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Roots grow blank the ground.
cards.note: Roots are down below the dirt. Under means below.

cards.q: Pick the word: We go ___ school in the morning.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: We go blank school in the morning.
cards.note: To tells which way you go. In the morning we go to school, not away from it.

cards.q: Pick the word: Put the milk ___ the cup.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: Put the milk blank the cup.
cards.note: Milk goes inside the cup, so we say in the cup.

cards.q: Pick the word: The rainbow is ___ the hill.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The rainbow is blank the hill.
cards.note: The rainbow is up high above the hill. Over means above.

cards.q: Pick the word: The ball fell ___ the shelf.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: The ball fell blank the shelf.
cards.note: The ball was on the shelf, then it came down. Off means away from the top.

cards.q: Pick the word: I eat lunch ___ my friend.
cards.sayQ: Pick the word: I eat lunch blank my friend.
cards.note: With tells who is there too. My friend eats next to me.

cards.q: The dog is under the bed. Which word tells where the dog is?
cards.note: Under is the where word. Dog and bed are naming words.

cards.q: The bird sits on the nest. Which word tells where the bird is?
cards.note: On is the where word. Bird and nest are naming words.
